prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1336; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- Records show the same major damage from an earlier, unreported accident; it is now claimed as new.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching the signalized intersection in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was southbound and turning left across the lane of travel. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and said it began at the time of impact. The Passenger, seated in the front right seat, confirmed being in the vehicle at the time of the collision and gave a statement consistent with Driver 1's account. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses at the corner gave matching accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door, which is consistent with the reported angle of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy involved. Records reviewed during the investigation show extensive damage to the same area of the vehicle from a prior incident that was never reported to police or the insurer, and that damage is now being presented as resulting from this collision. Whether the reported shoulder injury was caused by this crash has not yet been determined.
